author: Google
description:
Thanks for tuning into another episode of What’s New in Google Accessibility, a series where we share the latest news about our accessibility products and features. In this episode, we'll talk about accessibility features on Android, YouTube, Pixel, ChomeOS and Google Research. #WhatsNewInGoogle #Accessibility #Google #a11y 

0:33 Dark theme | Android  
0:53 Magnification | Android 
1:38 Talkback | Android 
2:37 Voice Access | Android 
3:22 AutoClick | Android 
3:57 Expressive Captions 
5:00 Magnifier app | Pixel 
5:24 ChromeVox mathML | ChromeOS
5:50 StreetReaderAI | Research 
6:45 NAI Guidebook | Research 

Check out our full series at https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL590L5WQmH8ce6ZPBbh0v1XVptLJXmQ0K   
To watch this video with American Sign Language (ASL) interpretation, please click here: https://youtu.be/1SLhLQaDOvE
To learn more, sign up for our accessibility newsletter at: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSemxYwYO_LRzm6Z6oI1Rxv5_cqEMv6_7JY2uo-1UWDuqlbzxA/viewform
